title: Gaisrinis automobilis
description: KLAUSIMAI RINKOS DALYVIAMS (Dėl planuojamo naudoto gaisrinio automobilio pirkimo techninės specifikacijos projekto) Klaipėdos rajono savivaldybės priešgaisrinė tarnyba planuoja vykdyti naudoto gaisrinio automobilio viešąjį pirkimą. Kviečiame rinkos dalyvius susipažinti su pridėtu techninės specifikacijos projektu ir pateikti savo įžvalgas CVP IS susirašinėjimo priemonėmis į šiuos klausimus: 1. Važiuoklės ir gaisrinio siurblio parametrai (2.2, 2.6 ir 3.15 p.): Ar rinkoje yra pakankama pasiūla naudotų 4x4 gaisrinių automobilių, pagamintų ne anksčiau kaip 2016 m. (Euro 6), turinčių ne mažesnį kaip 3 000 l/min našumo siurblį? Ar, jūsų vertinimu, sumažinus siurblio našumo reikalavimą iki 2 000 l/min, rinkos pasiūla ir konkurencija ženkliai padidėtų? 2. Pristatymo terminas (4.3 p.): Ar nustatytas iki 30 kalendorinių dienų pristatymo terminas (įskaitant pilną techninį aptarnavimą, žymėjimą pagal LST 1299:2004, techninę apžiūrą ir registraciją LR registre Pirkėjo vardu) yra realistiškas? Koks terminas būtų optimalus? 3. Garantijos sąlygos (5.1–5.5 p.): Kaip reikalavimas suteikti 12 mėnesių garantiją visam naudotam automobiliui (įskaitant važiuoklę ir elektroniką) veikia galutinę pasiūlymo kainą ir tiekėjų galimybes dalyvauti pirkime? Kokios garantijos sąlygos (trukmė ir apimtis) yra įprastos rinkoje perkant tokio amžiaus gaisrinę techniką? 4. Kiti techniniai reikalavimai: Ar specifikacijoje yra kitų perteklinių ar konkurenciją ribojančių reikalavimų (pvz., dėl LED apšvietimo, matmenų, komplektacijos)? Jei taip, nurodykite konkretų punktą ir siūlomą formuluotę. 5. Orientacinė kaina: Kokia preliminari techninės specifikacijos reikalavimus atitinkančio naudoto gaisrinio automobilio rinkos kaina (Eur be PVM ir su PVM)? ________________________________________

title: Netherlands – Services incidental to fishing – Visstandbeheer Loosdrechtse Plassengebied
description: Voor u ligt de Aanbestedingsleidraad van Waterschap Amstel Gooi en Vecht met betrekking tot het afsluiten van een Overeenkomst voor Diensten bestaande uit het contracteren van een gespecialiseerde marktpartij of combinatie van marktpartijen voor het voorbereiden en uitvoeren van visstandbeheer in het Loosdrechtse plassengebied. Het project maakt onderdeel uit van de KRW-maatregelen SGBP3 2023–2027 van waterschap AGV en draagt bij aan het behalen van de ecologische doelen voor gezond en schoon water. De Opdracht wordt uitgevoerd volgens een tweefasenaanpak, bestaande uit een Bouwteamfase en, na een positief besluit van Opdrachtgever, een Uitvoeringsfase. In de Bouwteamfase werken Opdrachtgever en Opdrachtnemer gezamenlijk de uitvoeringsstrategie en de daarvoor benodigde Bouwteamproducten uit. Van de marktpartij wordt daarbij een actieve, samenwerkingsgerichte en inhoudelijke inbreng verwacht vanuit praktische uitvoeringskennis en ervaring met visstandbeheer. De Opdracht wordt door middel van een Europese Openbare aanbestedingsprocedure in de markt gezet en zal worden gegund op basis van de Beste Prijs-Kwaliteitverhouding (BPKV), met de verhouding 20% (prijs) - 80% (kwaliteit). De kwalitatieve beoordeling bestaat uit twee gewogen Gunningscriteria: GC1 – Plan van Aanpak (50%) en GC2 – Voorstel Samenwerking (30%).

title: Norway – Research services – Operationalisation and measurement of the police ́s commitment to the stand-by area.
description: The aim of the assignment is to develop a research based framework for operationalisation and measuring the police ́s commitment to work within police stand-by. The framework shall identify and describe central dimensions by their commitment ability, as well as develop indicators that can be used to measure these in a systematic manner. Furthermore, the assignment shall identify relevant variables and data sources that can provide a basis for measuring the commitment ability and assess their suitability as regards reliability, validity, data quality and practical applicability. The research assignment shall contribute to a common and knowledge based understanding of what characterises the police ́s ability to focus on stand-by and how this can be measured and followed over time. The aim is to establish a professional basis that can be used for management, management, analysis, evaluation, prioritising and further development of the police ́s stand-by at local tactical level. Furthermore, it is a goal that the research shall contribute to increased knowledge on what factors affect the commitment ability, and make recommendations on how the commitment can be measured in a way that is both professionally robust and practically relevant for the police.

title: Finland – Refrigerating and freezing equipment – Laboratoriotason kylmälaitteet humaaninäytteiden, verituotteiden ja reagenssien säilytykseen
description: Hankinnan kohteena ovat Fimlab Laboratoriot Oy:n käyttöön tulevat laboratoriotason kylmälaitteet (Laitteet) humaaninäytteiden, verituotteiden ja reagenssien säilytykseen. Hankintaan sisältyy toimitus, asennus, käyttöönotto, tuki- ja huoltopalvelut sekä laitteisiin liittyvät tarvikkeet ja lisävarusteet tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä kuvatuin ehdoin. Hankinta on jaettu kuuteen osaan laitetyypittäin; laboratoriotason jääkaappi, laboratoriotason jääkaappi-pakastin, laboratoriotason pakastin, syväjääpakastin, verijääkaappi laboratoriokäyttöön ja verikeskustason plasmapakastimet. Kukin osa sisältää 1 - 4 osa-aluetta, jotka on muodostettu laitteen koon, ominaisuuden tai muun eriävän käyttötarkoituksen perusteella. Kuhunkin osa-alueeseen valitaan kaksi eri kauppanimeä (laitemallia), edellyttäen että hyväksyttyjä tarjouksia on riittävästi. Tarjoaja voi jättää yhden tarjouksen. Osatarjoukset ovat sallittuja sekä osien että osa-alueiden välillä. Tarjoaja voi tarjota kuhunkin tarjoamaansa osa-alueeseen yhtä tai enintään kahta eri kauppanimeä (laitemallia) ns. rinnakkaistarjouksena. Hintaliitteellä on arvio laitteiden hankintamääristä sopimuskaudella. Hankittavia Laitteita on eri tyyppisiä ja niitä hankitaan Tilaajan tarpeen mukaan (uusiin tarpeisiin ja nykyisten laitteiden tilalle niiden poistuttua käytöstä) pääosin Tilaajan toiminta-alueen tuotantolaboratorioihin (Tampere, Hämeenlinna, Jyväskylä, Lahti, Vaasa) ja satunnaisesti suurimpiin näytteenottokeskuksiin. Hankittava laitemäärä on arvio eikä se sido Tilaajaa. Toteutuvat hankintamäärät voivat olla siis arvioitua suurempia tai pienempiä. Hankinnalla pyritään varmistamaan laadukkaiden, turvallisten ja toimintavarmojen kylmälaitteiden saatavuus Fimlabin eri yksiköiden tarpeisiin kilpailukykyisin ehdoin. Laitteita koskeva sopimuskausi on kaksi vuotta. Sopimusta on mahdollista jatkaa yhdellä kahden (2) vuoden pituisella optiokaudella. title: Denmark – Printing services – Produktion, distribution og levering af det nationale sundhedskort, det særlige sundhedskort og det blå EU-sygesikringskort
description: Amgros I/S (Amgros) er et interessentskab med de fem regioner. Amgros gennemfører udbuddet som indkøbscentral, indgår kontrakten med den vindende tilbudsgiver og varetager den efterfølgende kontraktstyring. Regionerne og Udbetaling Danmark er aftagere under kontrakten og afholder betalingen for deres respektive aftag. Udbuddet vedrører en samlet løsning for produktion herunder indkøb og håndtering af materialer, trykning, pakning, frankering og levering af det nationale sundhedskort, det særlige sundhedskort og EU-sygesikringskort. Kontrakten omfatter en implementeringsperiode bl.a. fastlæggelse af kortenes design, etablering af nødvendige IT-integrationer samt gennemførelse af relevante test og prøver. Fra driftsdagen d. 1. april 2027, skal leverandøren på baggrund af modtagne bestillinger producere, distribuere og levere kortene til modtageradresser i Danmark og resten af verden. På baggrund af det historiske forbrug forventes et årligt aftag på ca. 3 mio. kort. Det faktiske aftag kan variere og kan afvige fra det forventede årlig aftag med +/- 30 %.

title: Denmark – Health and social work services – Genudbud af hjemmepleje og helhedspleje i Ishøj kommune
description: Dette udbud gennemføres som et genudbud efter annullation af et tidligere udbud, der blev offentliggjort den 26. juni 2026. Det tidligere udbud (TED nr. 445870-2026) blev annulleret, da ordregiver vurderede, at der var behov for væsentlige ændringer af udbudsgrundlaget. Udbuddet vedrører levering af helhedspleje, jf. ældrelovens §§ 5, 9, 10 og 11, hvilket omfatter personlig hjælp og støtte til nødvendige praktiske opgaver i hjemmet samt genoptræning af fysisk funktionsnedsættelse forårsaget af sygdom, der ikke behandles i tilknytning til en sygehusindlæggelse. Tøjvask- og indkøbsservice er ligeledes omfattet af udbuddet. Herudover omfatter udbuddet ydelser efter servicelovens § 83 samt delegerede sygeplejeydelser efter sundhedslovens § 138. Der er i udbuddet gennemført tiltag til fremme af bæredygtighed, herunder krav om overgang til emissionsfri transport for de køretøjer, der anvendes af sundheds- og plejepersonale. Kommunen forventer, at den årlige kontraktværdi udgør ca. 11,7 mio. kr. ekskl. moms. Udbuddet indeholder en option på køb af sygeplejeydelser, som forventes implementeret i 2028. Der foreligger på nuværende tidspunkt ikke en konkret beskrivelse af, hvordan dette skal gennemføres, da der endnu ikke er taget politisk stilling til eller vedtaget lovgivning om, i hvilket omfang sygeplejeopgaver skal kunne varetages af private leverandører. Udbuddet er af faglige, markedsmæssige og økonomiske årsager ikke opdelt i delkontrakter. Levering af helhedspleje kræver, at mange forskellige fagligheder bringes i spil, og et betydeligt opgavevolumen er nødvendigt for, at leverandøren kan ansætte medarbejdere med de nødvendige kompetencer til at varetage opgaverne i Ishøj Kommune. Derudover ønsker Ishøj Kommune, at leverandøren påtager sig en uddannelsesforpligtelse. Et vist opgavevolumen er i den forbindelse hensigtsmæssigt, så elever, praktikanter og lærlinge kan opnå erfaring med forskellige opgavetyper. Økonomiske forhold taler ligeledes imod en opdeling. En større koncentration af borgere inden for et geografisk område giver leverandøren bedre mulighed for effektiv ruteplanlægning og reduceret transporttid (ATA-tid), hvilket samtidig kan bidrage til mere konkurrencedygtige priser for kommunen.

Hankintasopimus on voimassa määräaikaisena kaksi (2) vuotta, jonka jälkeen se jatkuu toistaiseksi voimassa olevana. Sopimusten suunniteltu alkamisajankohta on 18.01.2027. description: Amgros I/S (Amgros) er et interessentskab med de fem regioner. Amgros gennemfører udbuddet som indkøbscentral, indgår kontrakten med den vindende tilbudsgiver og varetager den efterfølgende kontraktstyring. Regionerne og Udbetaling Danmark er aftagere under kontrakten og afholder betalingen for deres respektive aftag. Udbuddet vedrører en samlet løsning for produktion herunder indkøb og håndtering af materialer, trykning, pakning, frankering og levering af det nationale sundhedskort, det særlige sundhedskort og EU-sygesikringskort. Kontrakten omfatter en implementeringsperiode bl.a. fastlæggelse af kortenes design, etablering af nødvendige IT-integrationer samt gennemførelse af relevante test og prøver. Fra driftsdagen d. 1. april 2027, skal leverandøren på baggrund af modtagne bestillinger producere, distribuere og levere kortene til modtageradresser i Danmark og resten af verden. På baggrund af det historiske forbrug forventes et årligt aftag på ca. 3 mio. kort. Det faktiske aftag kan variere og kan afvige fra det forventede årlig aftag med +/- 30 %.

title: PR16354857 - Limited Competition Justification and Award Notice Outbound Shipments
description: The purpose of this notice is to comply with posting requirement, FAR Part 5 and Subpart 6.301. Competition was restricted to a limited number of vendors capable of meeting current operational requirements, including the ability to ship via alternative routes. This restriction is necessary due to constraints imposed by ongoing regional instability, which has rendered standard shipping routes unreliable or unavailable. Limiting competition to qualified vendors ensures continuity of outbound shipping services under current conditions. The security situation in the region remains fluid and subject to sudden escalation. Recurring, rapid changes in regional security conditions are affecting carrier availability, shipping routes, transit times, insurance requirements, and overall logistics reliability with little advance notice. Shipping activity through the Strait of Hormuz and other regional transportation corridors is unreliable and dangerous, with a result of limited bookings available from limited shippers In accordance with FAR 12.201-1(c)(2)(ii), simplified acquisition procedures, quotations were solicited from three vendors determined capable of meeting the Government�s requirements under current operational conditions. Three quotations were received and evaluated based on technical capability, compliance with the required scope of services, demonstrated ability to meet urgent logistical and delivery requirements, relevant past performance, and price reasonableness. The selected contractor was determined to represent the lowest-priced technically acceptable quotation $33,248 USD and demonstrated the capability to successfully perform the required services within the required timeframe and operational constraints. The contractor also demonstrated a strong record of relevant past performance supporting U.S. Embassy Kuwait requirements, including reliable and quality performance under similar operational conditions. Award to this contractor will support Shipping in maintaining uninterrupted mission operations and accomplishing mission requirements

title: 15BCTS26D00000018 - SU/MH Fort Worth, Texas
description: The Federal Bureau of Prisons seeks a contractor to provide community-based outpatient substance use disorder and mental health treatment services to male and female Adults in Custody (AICs) in community placement residing in a Residential Reentry Center (RRC), on home confinement, or on Federal Location Monitoring or, if applicable, reporting to a Day Reporting Center, in Fort Worth, Texas. Services are needed within a six (6) mile radius of Fritz G Lanham Federal Building, 819 Taylor Street, Fort Worth, Texas, 76102 and within a half (�) mile to a bus stop. This requirement will ensure the contractor is located within walking distance of public transportation, AICs are not subjected to walking long distances in inclement weather, and accountability of AICs is maintained at the performance site(s). Services are to be delivered in-person at performance site(s) meeting the solicitation restrictions and may also be provided by telehealth, according to SOW requirements. Telehealth is defined as audio-visual, two-way interactive communication. Audio-only services are allowed in limited circumstances and require pre-approval. The method of service delivery is contingent on the requirements of the contract, contractor capabilities, accessibility and technical availability of the AIC, and the type of service being rendered, e.g., intake and clinical assessments must be provided in-person, unless preauthorized on a case-by-case basis. The use of telehealth for the delivery of services must not be simply for the sake of convenience for the contractor or the AIC but based on sound clinical judgment, resulting in a treatment delivery of both in-person and telehealth services, as defined above, with very limited or no audio-only services taking place. Performance periods under this contract will be for a one-year base period estimated to begin on May 01, 2025, with four (4) one-year option periods, with services ending (if all options years are renewed) on April 30, 2030. The services required for this contract include a Base Year; Option Year One, Option Year Two, Option Year Three, and Option Year Four. All treatment services are to be provided by clinicians who currently hold a professional license to practice independently, without supervision, in the state of Texas. title: W58RGZ-26-B-0016 Amendment 0005
description: A-1. The purpose of Amendment (0005) to Solicitation W58RGZ-26-B-0016 is to answer industry questions. This special announcement notice serves as an amendment to the solicitation due to the sunset of PADDS and the solicitation not being moved to ACWS. A-2. The following questions have been asked by industry with the coordinated Government response. Industry Question 1- In regard to Solicitation# W58RGZ-27-B-0016, Overhaul of the UH-60 Radiator, Gearbox. Attachment (2), M&O Packaging Requirements, A request was made for clarification as to the fabrication of the Re-usable Container made from ISPM-15 compliant wood 30�x30�x34�or the modular reusable container. Is there an option to construct the container out of ISPM-15 compliant wood or must the container be the modular reusable container.(Pelican case) purchased by the contractor? Is the fabrication of the container made from ISPM-15 compliant wood 30�x30�x34 authorized for this contract? Government Response- The required container is the Modular Reusable, NSN: 8145-01-010-3776, P/N: 13414-501. The reference of ISPM-15 is saying ANY wood packaging material used at all must be compliant. That�s the pallet(s) they use to palletize the Modular Reusable Containers on for storing, stacking, handling & transporting the Radiator, Gearbox. It is NOT authorizing the fabrication of wood crates in lieu of the Modular Container. A-3. All other terms and conditions remain the same.

title: Common Armament Tester for Fighter (CAT-F)
description: This Synopsis serves as a notice of intent that the Automated Test System Contracting Branch, AFLCMC/ROKB, at Robins Air Force Base, GA, anticipates issuing a Request for Proposal (RFP) on SAM.gov under Notice ID FA8533-25-R-0002 for the Common Armament Tester-Fighters (CAT-F). This effort requires the design, development, manufacture, and sustainment of the CAT-F for the F-16, F-15, and A-10 platforms, capable of testing Preload, Clean Wing, and Fault Isolation Requirements at both O-Level and I-Level Maintenance. The North American Industry Classification System Code (NAICS) for this requirement is 334515, Instrument Manufacturing for Measuring and Testing Electricity and Electrical Signals, with a corresponding small business size standard of 750 employees, and Product or Service Code (PSC) 4920. This acquisition will be a Full and Open Competitive Acquisition with no small business set aside. This acquisition will utilize the Tradeoff Source Selection Procedures in accordance with the DoD Source Selection Procedures, dated 20 Aug 2022, and DAFFARS MP 5315.3. It will be comprised of an Initial Source Selection that will result in up to two (2) Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contracts to two (2) offerors with a Final Downselect to at least one (1) contractor following Critical Design Review (CDR). The Initial Source Selection will result in the award for CAT-F System Design. In the Initial Source Selection, the Government will conduct a full and open competition to narrow the competitive field down to no more than two (2) contractors that will execute CAT-F System Design and proceed to the Final Downselect. The Contracts will contain options for the execution of the program beyond the basic contract. The Final Downselect source selection will determine which contractor�s Option I may be exercised. The IDIQ contracts will utilize a mix of pricing arrangements, including Cost Plus Fixed Fee (CPFF), Firm Fixed Price (FFP), and Cost Reimbursement-No Fee (CR-NF). The Period of Performance for the resultant contracts shall include a 1 year Basic and 4 one year Options (in accordance with FAR 52.217-9, Option to Extend the Term of the Contract). The Basic is for Prototype Design and Digital Development of the O-Level and I-Level Testers. Option I is for EMD and Production but will only be exercised for the contractor(s) chosen during the Downselect. The following approximate quantities will be required for delivery during the Basic: Qty of 4 for the F-16 O-Level Handheld Tester Prototype Qty of 4 for the F-15 O-Level Handheld Tester Prototype Qty of 4 for the A-10 O-Level Handheld Tester Prototype The following approximate quantities will be required for delivery during Options I-IV: Qty of 303 EA for the F-16 O-Level Testers Qty of 172 EA for the F-15 O-Level Testers Qty of 68 EA for the A-10 O-Level Testers Qty of 143 EA for the F-16 I-Level Testers Qty of 80 EA for the F-15 I-Level Testers Qty of 42 EA for the A-10 I-Level Testers Delivery Schedule: O-Level Handheld Tester Prototypes will be delivered to begin 12 months ARO Order The approximate Request for Proposal (RFP) issue date is FY25 Q3, with a response date of 45 days later. In accordance with FAR 5.2079(c)(16)(i) All responsible sources may submit a bid, proposal, or quotation which shall be considered by the agency. Foreign Participation is not permitted. All comments, recommendations, concerns, and questions in regards to this notice should be submitted to the PCO, Oya Harrison, oya.harrison.1@us.af.mil and the Contract Specialist, Alexis Davis, Alexis.Davis.13@us.af.mil.

title: Notification of Availability of Software Framework, Warped Alloy, for Software Defined Radio (SDR) Signal Chain
description: The Department of the Army is pleased to announce the availability of a cutting-edge software framework designed to enhance the capabilities of Software Defined Radio (SDR) systems. This framework enables the SDR signal chain to dynamically adjust its capabilities based on the sensed RF environment and to respond at the protocol level in real-time. The Department of the Army is releasing this software framework to foster collaboration with industry partners and encourage the integration of this technology into their SDR products. The intent is to enable greater flexibility in conducting radio frequency operations, allowing industry partners to leverage this framework to enhance their SDR systems' adaptability and operational effectiveness. By providing this framework, we aim to advance the state of SDR technology and promote innovation in the field of radio frequency operations. Key Features of the Framework: Rapid Reconfiguration: The framework allows for swift reconfiguration of the RF signal processing chain modules within the SDR�s field programmable gate array (FPGA), ensuring adaptability to varying operational requirements. FPGA-Based Physical Layer (PHY) and Media Access Control (MAC): The framework enables the rapid development and implementation of a fully-customized PHY and MAC layer that supports various signals and waveforms, providing a comprehensive solution for SDR applications. Elements Available for Industry: FPGA Top-Level Framework: This top-level hardware description language (HDL) framework resides within the SDR FPGA, facilitating seamless communication between the General-Purpose Processor (GPP) and the signal modules. Application Programming Interface (API): A user-friendly, common C-based API is provided, allowing developers to create SDR-agnostic applications that can manipulate the programmed signal FPGA modules effectively. Transport Interface (TI): The TI consists of dynamic or static C libraries utilized during application builds, enabling efficient message transport to and from user-based applications and FPGA signal modules. Exemplar Data Generation/Consumption Module: This module serves as a testing tool for hardware-specific implementations of the framework, ensuring compatibility and performance validation. Documentation: Comprehensive documentation will be made available, including development environment guides and a developer's guide, to assist industry partners in effectively utilizing the framework. The Department of the Army encourages industry partners to engage with this innovative framework, which is expected to significantly advance the capabilities of SDR technology. The Government retains all rights of modifications made to the original framework. To access this software interested parties shall complete the attached Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) (Attachment 1). Individuals identified as contractor representatives/users pursuant to signed/complete NDAs may then create an account on Test Resource Management Center (TRMC) to access the codebase. A step-by-step guide for creating a TRMC account and accessing the repository is included in Attachment 2. INSTRUCTIONS FOR COMPLETING THE NDA: An authorized representative of each contractor organization is to complete the following steps to ensure the NDA is processed correctly: Complete all fields on page 1. title: Market Survey for Helicopter Services for the FAA between Juneau and other Sites in Alaska
description: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) is conducting a Market Survey seeking to identify interested and capable sources. Sources must respond with information to confirm evidence of their qualifications and capabilities. Responses to this market Survey will be sued to determine if there is adequate competition to set the requirements aside for Socially and Economically Disadvantage Businesses, small Businesses, or full and open competition. This survey is being conducted in accordance with the FAA Acquisition management System (AMS) Section 3.2.1.2.1. This Market Survey will support market research obtained from multiple sources and will be utilized for planning purposes only. All interested vendors are advised that the FAA will not pay for any information or any administrative costs incurred that are associated with any response received from industry in response to this Market Survey. Therefore, any costs associated with the vendor�s market Survey submissions will be solely at the expense for the interested vendor. The general scope of work under the proposed contract will be that the contractor must provide all labor, supplies, supervision, tools, materials, equipment, transportation, and licenses or permits necessary to provide the air charter transportation services in accordance with this specification. The intended NAICS is 481211, Nonscheduled Chartered Passenger Air Transportation. Location: Between Juneau, Alaska and locations in southeast Alaska. RESPONSE TO THIS MARKET SURVEY: Any information provided in response to this Market Survey will be used for informational purposes only and will not be released. Any proprietary information submitted will be protected if appropriately marked. Vendor participation in any informational session is not a promise of future business with the FAA. Responses must include the following information: Name of the company, including any DBA name Address Phone Point of Contact Email address Business size status; 8(a), Small, SDVOSB, WOSB, etc. Verification of active registration at SAM.gov Submit response for the Market Survey by 4:00 PM., Pacific Time on November 30, 2026, 4:00 PM Pacific Time. Responses including attachments, must be submitted electronically and received in the email inbox of: Angela.Furukawa@faa.gov, by the due date and time stated above. There are no attachments. Note: the scope of work is subject to change prior to the solicitation date.

title: RRC Services located within the city limits of the following cities within San Bernardino County, CA: San Bernardino, Fontana, Rancho Cucamonga, Bloomington, Colton, Grand Terrace, Highland, Loma Linda, and Redlands
description: The Federal Bureau of Prisons (Bureau) is seeking concerns having the ability for providing Residential Reentry Center (RRC) services (in-house RRC beds) and Home Confinement services (home confinement placements) for male and female Federal offenders held under the authority of United States Statutes located within the city limits of the following cities within San Bernardino County, CA: San Bernardino, Fontana, Rancho Cucamonga, Bloomington, Colton, Grand Terrace, Highland, Loma Linda, and Redlands and Home Confinement radius is within 100 miles of the RRC Facility. Both the RRC services for in-house RRC beds and the Home Confinement services for home confinement placements shall be in accordance with the Federal Bureau of Prisons Statement of Work entitled, "Residential Reentry Center, March 2022 SOW�. Home Confinement services (for home confinement placements) are specifically defined in chapter 10, Programs, of the aforementioned SOW. Additional requirements for these services are referenced throughout the SOW as well. This will be an indefinite delivery, indefinite quantity type contract with firm fixed unit prices for all line items. The RRC In-House requirement will consist of a maximum of 70 beds in which 56 beds will be designated for males and 14 beds designated for females for the One-year Base Period and each of the Four One-year Option Periods. The Home Confinement requirement will consist of a maximum of 40 placements to include both males and females for the One-year Base Period and each of the Four One-year Option Periods. The Home Confinement Radius must be within 100 miles of the RRC facility. It is the intent of the Government to award both line items (RRC in-house beds and home confinement placements) to a single provider, as these services are interconnected and rely upon each other to ensure adequate programming and case management of offenders. The Government reserves the right to potentially make an award which is deemed to be in the best interest of the Government. 15BRRC27R00000009 will be available on or about November 10, 2026, and it will be distributed solely through the Government Point of Entry website at www.sam.gov. Hard copies of the solicitation will not be available. The site provides downloading instructions. Future information about this acquisition will also be distributed through this site. Interested parties are responsible for monitoring this site to ensure that they have the most up-to-date information about this acquisition. The estimated closing date of 15BRRC27R00000009 will be on or about January 11, 2026. Any questions regarding the pre-solicitation notice can be addressed to Jeremy Essler at jessler@bop.gov by Monday, October 19, 2026 at 2:00PM ET. All responsible sources may submit a proposal which will be considered by this agency. No collect calls will be accepted. No telephone request or written requests for the solicitation will be accepted.
